title: Quote: Funny enough, 20 years after we started Apple, there was nob...
speaker: Steve Jobs
event: Apple and Pixar: Steve's Two Jobs
content: Funny enough, 20 years after we started Apple, there was nobody building computers for people again. You know? They were trying to sell consumers last year's corporate computers. We said, 'Well, these are our roots. This is why we're here. The world doesn't need another Dell or Compaq. They need an Apple.'
full_transcript: Funny enough, 20 years after we started Apple, there was nobody building computers for people again. You know? They were trying to sell consumers last year's corporate computers. We said, 'Well, these are our roots. This is why we're here. The world doesn't need another Dell or Compaq. They need an Apple.'
